name: engine-pin-recorded
body: Every frontend container states its engine pin with an exact version — or, where upstream ships no version for a vendored engine/grammar, an explicit content/ABI identity — and the language-version ceiling that pin imposes. Where the ceiling is the user's installed toolchain rather than the pin alone (Go, Java, Rust), the container says so jointly. A frontend container that records neither an engine version nor a content/ABI identity for an unversioned vendored engine is a violation. All eight frontend containers satisfy this: Go/Java/Rust state the joint pin + installed-toolchain ceiling; TypeScript/C#/Python state exact engine versions; Markdown has no language ceiling to impose; and C++ records the tree-sitter language ABI v15 plus its vendored tree-sitter-cpp grammar content.
